subject: Cognify usage bands, budget anchor, and startup sweetener request
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Chen <sophie@cognify.ai>, procurement@cognify.ai
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo notes — usage bands, $/1M anchor, and starter credit ask

Hi Sophie / Cognify team — great demo earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align on pricing and an incentive that fits your stage: 

Key takeaways from the call:
- Primary workload: document ingestion + semantic search + chat UX. Expect majority tokens on generation for chat and periodic bulk embedding runs.
- Typical prompt length: 350–700 tokens per request; peak concurrent user sessions ~40 in week 1 of pilot.
- Goal: move from pilot (2–4 weeks) to production if latency & cost look good.

We need two confirmations to create a clean pricing proposal and any startup sweetener: 
1) Budget anchor: what is the monthly budget range you’re targeting for LLM inference during the first 3 months of the pilot? (ballpark is fine: <$5k, $5–20k, $20–50k, >$50k)
2) Target unit economics: is there an internal target of $/1M tokens we should use when modelling? If not, we typically show scenarios at $80, $60, and $45 per 1M tokens depending on commitment and quantization.

Starter credit / founders path request: Cognify mentioned being a seed-stage startup. If you can share a one-line investor / founder intro (or confirm stage), I’ll route a founders-track starter credit request to our GTM team. Typical starter sweetener is a one-time credit + 10–20% first-year off on committed volume.

Attachments: I’ve attached a simple token forecast template for you to drop in expected call volume (cognify-token-forecast.xlsx).

Next steps I propose:
- Sophie confirms budget band + target $/1M tokens (reply to this thread)
- We’ll produce 2 pricing scenarios: a light trial (no commit) and a starter commit (3–6 month minimum) with the founder sweetener applied if you qualify
- If procurement wants standard terms, copy procurement@cognify.ai and we’ll include procurement checklist and starter credit terms PDF

Thanks — I’ll wait for your numbers and will turn around scenarios within 48 hours.

— Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

--Attachment: cognify-token-forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Sophie Chen <sophie@cognify.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cognify.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo notes — usage bands, $/1M anchor, and starter credit ask

Thanks Rachel — quick answers below. Appreciate the clear recap.

Budget anchor: for pilot we’re aiming at the $5–20k / month bucket (likely toward the low end initially; can scale if latency/costs are solid).
Token target: we don’t have a hard $/1M target, but $60/1M sounds reasonable as an internal target for planning. If you can show a scenario at $45 and $60 that’d help.

We are seed-stage (Series Seed closed Q1 2026) — happy to share a one-line intro from our CEO if it helps with founders-track eligibility.

Procurement: forwarding to procurement@cognify.ai — they’ll want a sample SOW + terms.

Sophie
Sophie Chen
Head of Product, Cognify
sophie@cognify.ai

Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing scenarios and starter-commit proposal (Cognify)

Hi Sophie — thanks for the quick reply and confirmation on stage. I’ve sketched two scenarios below (high-level) and attached the starter credit terms PDF for transparency. If this looks in range, I’ll pull numbers into the forecast you sent back.

Scenario A — Trial (no commit)
- On-demand pricing: $80 / 1M tokens (reference); best when you want no commitment and short pilot.
- Pros: no min spend, simple onboarding. Cons: higher unit cost at scale.

Scenario B — Starter commit (3 months minimum)
- Committed band: 5–20M tokens / month with a 10% commit discount baseline.
- Pricing examples: 
  • If commit 10M tokens/month: effective $60 / 1M tokens after the commit discount + automatic microbatching suggestions we apply.
  • If commit 20M tokens/month: effective $50 / 1M tokens with basic quantization profile.
- Founders sweetener (subject to approval): one-time $5k credit + additional 10% off in month 1 if Cognify provides founder intro and signs up within 14 days.

Procurement checklist: I attached our starter-credit terms and a one-page SOW template. If procurement sends their standard PO workflow, we can align the SOW to that.

Attachments: redwood-starter-credit-terms.pdf

Can you confirm: a) whether procurement will run the short SOW route or need our standard MSA redlines, and b) whether you’ll provide the CEO intro for founders-track? Once I have that, I’ll request the founders-track approval and formalize the pricing sheet.

Thanks — I’ll start prepping the two scenario worksheets.

— Rachel

--Attachment: redwood-starter-credit-terms.pdf (PDF)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing scenarios and starter-commit proposal (Cognify)

Quick internal / reply-all note — we can support the founders sweetener as outlined (one-time $5k credit + 10% month-1 off) if Cognify signs a 3-month starter commit at >=10M tokens/month. I’ve tentatively approved the extra 5% rebate in month 2 as a performance sweetener if they reach the 10M/month threshold.

Rachel: formatting request — include the HubSpot deal link and explicit line-item for ‘founders credit applied’ in the quote so procurement can see it.

Sophie / procurement: if you want to fast-track, fill the forecast spreadsheet and return it, and we’ll issue a preliminary quote + credit memo within 48 hours.

— Karthik
